title: Volatility-gated trend continuation
thesis: A crypto perpetual that breaks above a closed-bar range during expanding volatility should have positive forward expectancy after explicit trading costs.
market_mechanism: Momentum traders and forced hedging can extend moves after confirmed range expansion, but the edge should disappear in low-liquidity or mean-reverting states.
entry_condition_intent: Enter long only after a closed signal bar confirms a range breakout with volatility above a pre-registered floor.
exit_condition_intent: Exit via fixed ATR stop, time stop, or trend failure on closed signal bars.
invalidation_criteria: Net expectancy is not positive after fees and slippage across out-of-sample symbols.
Performance is dominated by fewer than three rare trades.
The strategy fails the null benchmark after cost perturbation.
cost_model_assumptions: Use explicit maker/taker fees plus conservative round-trip slippage before any promotion.
benchmark_or_null: Compare against random-entry same-hold-time null and buy-and-hold benchmark.
out_of_sample_plan: Hold out the final third of the panel by time and require stable rank across stable and volatile universes.
